ValidationRule.description: Block Community creation until the parent Market Account has Scope of Work, BMG pricing, and Contract populated.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($Profile.Name = "System Administrator"), (AND( NOT(ISBLANK(Builder_Account__c)), OR( ISBLANK(Builder_Account__r.Scope_Of_Work_Link__c), ISBLANK(Builder_Account__r.BMG_Link__c), ISBLANK(Builder_Account__r.Contract_Link__c) ) )) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Market Account must have Scope of Work, BMG pricing, and Contract populated before a Community can be created. Update the Market Account, then try again.
